one_line: Show the real installation and a steady POV of the finished product in the child's room, not just claims.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a girl about 3 in pyjamas stands on a bed, a small white remote in her hand, smiling. Voiceover and subtitle: 'מאז שהיא נולדה', then 'הכי חשוב לי זה הבטיחות והשינה שלה בלילה'. The fan is named at 0:04.
q1_hook.why: A cheerful child and the parent's voice start together (H1, H4), and the line is said and subtitled (H6). But the product is named only at 0:04 and the fan is not on screen until 0:06, so the first 3 s give a mood and a priority, not what the Reel is about (H2).

beats.what: Girl on a bed with the remote; 'מאז שהיא נולדה', 'בחרנו במאוורר תקרה של סטאר' (0:04)
beats.why: A parent priority and a warm child; product named late.

beats.what: An adult fits the fan to the ceiling; 'מותג ותיק עם 80 שנות ניסיון', 'חשמלאים'
beats.why: Brand facts over installation answer the safety worry.

beats.what: POV hand with the Star remote, the fan running in the child's room; 'שזה מעל מיטה של ילדים'
beats.why: The clearest shot: finished product, real room, remote.

beats.what: Girl poses on the bed with the remote; 'הוא שקט ברמה שלא שומעים אותו'
beats.why: The child returns as the emotional break; the quiet is not visible.

beats.what: Handheld close-up of the light from below, then a dark room; 'אור נעים לפני השינה'
beats.why: Shows the dimmer, the one feature that can be seen.

beats.what: Dark room, fan turning; 'בסוף, זה פשוט גורם לי להרגיש הרבה יותר רגועה כשהיא ישנה'

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. No question, no send or save reason, no comment word in the video or caption.
q2_flow.why: The arc runs from a parent's priority, through reasons, to a calm night, and ends on the feeling it began with (K2, R4). In between, each 6 to 8 s shot carries one spoken brand fact, a list with little new to see (R3). The quiet claim cannot be seen, and the dark last shot adds nothing visible (R1).

q3_cta.what: None. The video ends on 'בסוף, זה פשוט גורם לי להרגיש הרבה יותר רגועה כשהיא ישנה'. The caption has no ask; its last line is 'בשיתוף @star_fans_il'. No link, code, price or keyword.
q3_cta.why: The calm last line is a clean finish (E8), but a parent who wants the fan has no next step: no link, no dealer, no price (C6). Nothing invites a comment or a send either (C4, R6), so the Reel earns attention and converts none of it.

q4_shown.what: The remote in the child's hand 0:00 to 0:05, no fan yet; an adult fitting the fan 0:06 to 0:13; a POV hand, remote and running fan 0:14 to 0:21; the child posing 0:22; the dimmed light 0:28; a dark room 0:31. No price.
q4_shown.why: Installation and a running fan in a real child's room answer the safety and fit worries (K5). The child using the remote shows everyday use (S1). 'Quiet' and 'pleasant air' are claims only (K4). 80 years and certified installers are brand facts (S6). The child's name is on the wall in her shots (S5).

q5_edit.what: 6 shots in 37 s (about 6 s each), straight cuts near 6, 14, 22, 28 and 31 s; no speed changes seen. Subtitles follow every voiceover sentence in 1 to 2 lines. Ends on a dark handheld night shot with the last subtitle.
q5_edit.why: Shots of 6 to 8 s with a narrated fact each are slower than the research pace and read like a narrated slide show (E2, R3). Subtitles repeat the whole voiceover (T2). At 37 s the length suits a demo (R2). The dark last shot is weak (E8).

q6_topic.what: A mother's reasons for a ceiling fan with a light in her child's room: safe installation, quiet air, a dimmer for bedtime. Serves parents upgrading a child's room for sleep.
q6_topic.why: It starts from a real concern, safe sleep, and ends on the parent's calm (K6). The safety worry about a fan over a child's bed is a smart thing to answer. The facts arrive as a spoken list with no story moment, and 'עושה הבדל ענק' is unproven (K4).

q7_filmed.what: Phone, static and handheld: a static medium shot of the girl on a bed; a low-angle handheld installation shot; a POV hand holding the remote in a daylit room; a handheld close-up of the light; a dark handheld night shot. One adult, one child.
q7_filmed.why: The POV remote shot is the cleanest: bright, steady, hand and remote large in the frame (F5, F4). The child shots feel homemade and warm (H8). The night shot is dark, grainy and shaky, so the key 'calm sleep' image is the weakest (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: White subtitles with a dark outline, 1 to 2 lines, at about 75% of the frame height, following every voiceover sentence: 'מאז שהיא נולדה' (0:00), 'הכי חשוב לי זה הבטיחות והשינה שלה בלילה' (0:02), 'מותג ותיק עם 80 שנות ניסיון' (0:06), 'הוא שקט ברמה שלא שומעים אותו' (0:22). No headline card, no emoji.
q8_text.caption: 'כשזה נוגע לילדים שלי' then 'אני לא מתפשרת על בטיחות ושינה טובה בלילה 🤍'. Six short lines: a parent priority, the product named once, a result line, 'בשיתוף @star_fans_il'. No hashtags, no question, no CTA.
q8_text.why: Subtitles on every sentence let a muted viewer follow (T1), but they are a full transcript in the bottom 35% (T2, T4, F2). The caption opens with the video's own priority and names the product once, with no hashtags to help search (T7). 'בשיתוף' is on the last line (T8, S7).

weak_points: Fan named at 0:04 and shown at 0:06; subtitles repeat every sentence in the bottom band; brand facts read as a script; quietness cannot be seen; dark, shaky ending; no next step.
lumebook_takeaway: A steady top-down hands shot of the book in a real child's room, one worry answered in a subtitle, one calm last line. No child face.
not_verified: How quiet the fan is (cannot be heard). Whether the adult installing is a company installer. The paid-partnership label (0 per media info). Music (none evident). Correction: only the remote is in the child's hand at 0:00; the fan first appears at 0:06 and whole at 0:14. The machine transcript misreads the opening words, so quotes follow the subtitles. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
